title: The maximal volume of projections of the cross-polytope
summary: We prove the conjectured sharp upper bound for the volume of an arbitrary lower-dimensional orthogonal projection of the regular cross-polytope. More generally, for every spanning family $v_1,\dots,v_n \in \mathbb{R}^k, $ we prove \[ \operatorname{vol}\nolimits_{k} \operatorname{conv} \{\pm v_1, \dots, \pm v_n\} \le \frac{2^k}{k!} \sqrt{\det\!\left(\sum_{i=1}^n v_i\otimes v_i\right)}. \] After the natural normalization, equality holds precisely when the non-zero vectors form an orthonormal basis.
